points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 9965be84 clean CMake build succeeds in restricted cfd-bench container with image dependencies; curated report cannot be rebuilt without excluded figures.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:58–100 parses case/output/flux/limiter and errors on unknown options; :125–128 accepts restart but explicitly cold-starts.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Config, GlobalMesh, Partition, Solver, TimeLoop and Output isolate major responsibilities; interfaces remain specific to 2-D perfect gas.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected Physics.hpp, Solver.cpp, TimeLoop.cpp and Halo.hpp implement the numerical core directly; no affirmative copied-core evidence in this review, without exhaustive authorship search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Config.cpp:60–135 reads the supplied case and run type; GlobalMesh.cpp reads the requested CGNS path. Documented Re20 flux override is a CLI choice, not a filename branch.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Partition.cpp:10–38 calls METIS, Halo.hpp:19–47 exchanges neighbor data; gradients and limiters are exchanged in Solver.cpp:111–112,151. GlobalMesh scope ends before solve.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: GlobalMesh.cpp:227–232 warns on unmatched boundaries and Partition.cpp:153 treats them as farfield; TimeLoop.cpp:89–104 rejects nonpositive updates. Unknown meshes are not exhaustively tested.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Submitted validator passes eight cases and report; results_tables.tex provides rank comparisons. No independent grid-convergence demonstration or new CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source is split by responsibility with readable comments; CMakeLists.txt sets Release -march=native and source glob, limiting portability and reproducibility.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Physics.hpp defines perfect-gas conservative/primitive conversion and inviscid flux; Config.cpp reads freestream and Reynolds parameters.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: GlobalMesh.cpp:56–155 imports unstructured CGNS tri/quad and MIXED sections; :193–234 welds zones and builds adjacency. Boundary matching uses section names and unmatched faces only warn.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Solver.cpp:266–292 adds interior face flux to owner and opposite sign to local neighbor, with partition boundary handled through halo; no separate conservation test executed.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Physics.hpp:70–124 supplies Roe and Harten–Yee eigenvalue treatment; Solver.cpp:280–288 selects Roe or Rusanov.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Solver.cpp:165–227 uses characteristic farfield, pressure slip and no-slip adiabatic wall flux; wall output explicitly reports zero boundary velocity in Forces.cpp:69–74.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Solver.cpp:90–112 computes least-squares primitive gradients and exchanges them; :154–162 reconstructs at faces with positivity fallback. No formal order study supplied.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Solver.cpp:115–151 computes and exchanges Venkatakrishnan factors; TimeLoop.cpp:219–225 freezes them in steady cases, transient recomputes each inner iteration.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Solver.cpp:230–263 computes primitive-gradient Newtonian stress and Fourier heat with corrected face gradients; Forces.cpp:50–55 integrates full traction, not the tangential-only split claimed by report.tex:138–141.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: TimeLoop.cpp:20–87 uses spectral-radius LU-SGS and neighbor increments; :166–179 uses ramped local CFL. Steady rollback can accept a plateau, with M2 reported.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: TimeLoop.cpp:304–379 freezes two histories, bootstraps BDF1 then BDF2 and measures actual target misses; original metadata gives 5–153 iterations and zero misses.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS graph partition, owned/ghost exchange and reductions are implemented; original NACA np1/8 Cd 0.000782/0.000929 and cylinder np2/8 Cd 0.878030/0.877966 demonstrate selected comparisons.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original eight final packages and report pass validator; Output.cpp:283–297 writes state restart, but main.cpp:125–128 does not read it.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Existing explicit validator reports eight cases and report pass; this is structural evidence rather than proof of numerical accuracy.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Original runs reach reported endpoints and transient target statistics are counted; M2 inviscid plateaus at 2.10 orders, M2 laminar Cd remains evolving in final 10%.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re200 St=0.190 matches 0.189919 from original history, but Re20 Cd=0.878 versus reference≈2 and late laminar force variation constrain accuracy; rank checks are limited examples.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Contestant expressly delivered 42 case figures; three inviscid plots meet floor. Four steady viscous and Re200 full force graphs flatten late signals under startup spikes.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report discloses low-Mach error and M2 plateau; results_tables.tex labels the transient final-force row as a mean, and report.tex:138–141 mislabels full viscous traction as tangential.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Workspace figure_manifest.csv maps contestant plots to original case data; checked plots precede selected final response. Figure assets/manifest excluded from immutable tip limit report rebuilding.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable CMake build passes; contract validator passes; --restart is accepted but ignored and bad options throw. Output.cpp writes actual binary state.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: GlobalMesh.cpp:56–155 reads unstructured mixed tri/quad sections, :193–234 welds and builds face graph. BC matching uses section names and unmatched faces warn/fall back to farfield.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Solver.cpp:165–227,266–292 assembles conservative face fluxes with Roe/Rusanov and characteristic/slip/no-slip treatments; general BC tagging weakness limits robustness.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Solver.cpp:90–162 supplies LS gradients, exchanged limiter and positivity fallback; TimeLoop.cpp freezes steady limiter but reconstruction remains active. No formal smooth-order study.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Solver.cpp:230–263 implements velocity/temperature gradients, stress and heat; Forces.cpp:33–55 integrates full traction rather than the claimed tangential-only split.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: TimeLoop.cpp:20–87 and :304–379 implement implicit LU-SGS and frozen-history BDF2 with measured target checks. Restart is cold-start only; Re200 target accounting is genuine.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Partition.cpp:10–38 calls METIS, Halo.hpp exchanges neighbor owned/ghost data, force and residual reductions exist; rank np1/8 NACA and np2/8 Re20 are documented. Global mesh is freed before iterations.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Three inviscid cases broadly plausible, M2 plateau disclosed; laminar final force evolution and Re20 Cd≈0.878 versus ≈2 limit accuracy; Re200 St≈0.190 with target accounting. Rank comparisons supplied.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report discusses schemes, plateau and low-Mach error; delivered plots/manifest exist, but late force history is flattened in several cases and Re200 final row is mislabeled mean; curated figure omission impedes rebuilding.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case config and component files separate mesh, flux, solver and output; physics and geometry remain fixed 2-D perfect gas with limited boundary/extension interfaces.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Score 2→3. Accepted PDF p3 reports Cd=0.0009, Cl=0.0001; contestant-delivered report/figures/naca0012_m015_inviscid_{residuals,forces,mach}.png show residual progression, damped force history and case Mach field. The force scale limits late precision; original last 10% Cd 0.000659–0.001073 and Cl −0.000110–0.000514. Approximately four residual orders and near-zero drag/lift are plausible, but late scatter and absence of grid-convergence evidence limit confidence.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: Score 2→3. Accepted PDF p3 reports Cd=0.0087, Cl≈0; contestant-delivered report/figures/naca0012_m080_inviscid_{residuals,forces,mach}.png show residual and force histories and the transonic Mach field. Last 10% Cd 0.00871636–0.00872386, Cl 0.00001264–0.00002348; 3.93 residual orders and near-symmetric force support an adequate result, without independent grid convergence or quantitative shock validation.

naca0012_m200_inviscid.notes: Score 2→3. Accepted PDF p3 reports Cd=0.0909, Cl≈0; contestant-delivered report/figures/naca0012_m200_inviscid_{residuals,forces,mach}.png show residual, force and supersonic Mach field. Original last 10% Cd 0.0908842–0.0909602, Cl −0.0001374–0.0001657. Only 2.10 residual orders versus four requested; report.tex:289–292 discloses best-residual plateau with stable force. Credible broad shock/force outcome with material convergence limitation.

naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: Score remains 2. PDF p3 reports Cd=0.036965, Cl=−0.000389. Delivered case-specific residuals, Mach field and force history are in report/figures; the force plot startup Cd≈330 compresses the late Cd≈0.037 and lift near zero, so final behavior is unreadable. Original last 10% Cd 0.036965–0.047383 and Cl −0.000898 to −0.000178; four-order target reached but still-evolving drag and the plot floor limit the score.

naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: Score remains 2. PDF p3 reports Cd=0.041546, Cl=0.005967. Delivered case-specific residuals and Mach field exist, but startup Cd≈330 flattens the late force history, leaving force behavior unreadable. Original last 10% Cd 0.041546–0.043198, Cl 0.004826–0.006648; target four residual orders met, while asymmetric lift and remaining variation limit confidence.

naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Score remains 2. PDF p3 reports Cd=0.217650, Cl=0.000148. Delivered case-specific residuals and Mach field exist; startup Cd≈330 makes the final force history unreadable. Last 10% Cd 0.217650–0.307258 and Cl −0.000300–0.000148 despite reaching the requested three residual orders: appreciable drag evolution and missing readable force behavior limit confidence.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Score remains 2. PDF p3 reports Cd=0.877966, Cl=0.004535; PDF p7 and delivered figures provide wake contours and residual history. The delivered force plot has startup Cd≈360, rendering late Cd≈0.878 unreadable. Last 10% Cd 0.877966–0.878294 and Cl 0.004535–0.004557, 4.92 residual orders; report.tex:293–300 admits substantial underprediction versus reference Cd≈2 from low-Mach dissipation. Steady behavior exists but quantitative force error and unreadable force history limit score.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 2 retained after the completed numerical review. Contestant-delivered accepted report PDF p3 gives mean Cd=0.919, lift amplitude 0.388, St=0.190; p8 gives wake vorticity and full force history. Original forces.csv at t>=150 has mean Cd=0.9187081 and Cl range -0.387379 to 0.387772; 28 mean-lift crossing periods average 5.26541, frequency 0.189919. The accepted PDF omits a Re200 residual plot, but the contestant also explicitly delivered 42 figures and a figure manifest in its final response; its case-specific figures/cylinder_m010_laminar_re200_residuals.png is readable and predates that response. The delivered force plot has no readable late-time drag: startup spike ~31 compresses the small late oscillation. Thus the delivered-evidence floor still caps at 2. The original numeric/St citations are valid; missing curated figure files are separately a reproducibility limitation, not proof the accepted PDF lacks figures.

flags.text: metadata/status marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
flags.evidence: M2 inviscid 2.10-order best-residual plateau is disclosed in report.tex:289–292; original final 10% Cd 0.090884–0.090960. Transient TimeLoop.cpp:340–379 counts actual target misses and metadata records zero. Other steady target runs and their force limitations are noted separately.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; cylinder Re200 was never rerun.
Structural validation is separate from substantive numerical scoring.
Raw solver artifacts remain workspace evidence and were excluded from the curated submission tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

2026-10-30 partial recalibration: accepted contestant PDF is checked as delivered evidence, separately from reproducibility of figures omitted from the curated tip. Other case scores, rubric and DQ remain under review.

2026-10-30 full source calibration: no CFD rerun; clean immutable-source build passed in network-disabled restricted container. No exhaustive external authorship or pixel-level audit. Explicitly delivered standalone plots were evaluated with session and manifest provenance; omitted curated figures still prevent independent report rebuilding.
